candidates.yourNature_desc: You are the field that never closes for the season. Whatever lands near you gets grown, invited or not, and the ledger with everyone you feed runs quietly lopsided. It's the kind of generosity that looks bottomless right up to the season it isn't. Even good ground needs to lie fallow. Yours is the last to hear it.

self_card.presence: Anything planted near you grows, invited or not. The season never closes, and the field forgets that even good ground needs to lie fallow.
